title: Magic state cultivation: growing T states as cheap as CNOT gates
conversion_notes: Replace designated injection and kickback S/S_DAG proxies with T/T_DAG using correct signs; do not replace every S. Compare published exact Clifft circuits and verify detectors.
notes: Generator covers injection, cultivation and escape; Zenodo provides circuits.zip and code.zip.

title: High Rate Magic State Cultivation on the Surface Code
conversion_notes: Identify proxy rotation or controlled-Clifford decomposition and replace with actual non-Clifford gates; conversion unverified.
notes: Repository describes Stim/Sinter circuit generation and statevector simulations. Earlier title Efficient Magic State Cultivation on the Surface Code. H, HXY and CX protocols.

title: Efficient Magic State Cultivation on RP^2
conversion_notes: Locate injection and magic-check S/S_DAG proxies and selectively replace with T/T_DAG, verifying sign and detectors; exact conversion unverified.
notes: Author README identifies Stim files including rp_3_T_cult.stim and end-to-end growth.

title: Fold-transversal surface code cultivation
authors: Sahay, Tsai, Chang, Su, Smith, Singh, Puri
conversion_notes: Repository describes |Y> proxy; adapt injection and controlled fold-transversal measurement to non-Clifford gates using paper; exact conversion unverified.
notes: Includes fd3_baseline_ckt.stim and fd5_base_new.stim; generator describes fault-distance-3 |Y> cultivation and stabilizer-based escape.

title: Constant-depth magic state cultivation with Clifford measurements by gauging
conversion_notes: Inspect generated gauging and escape circuits to identify preparation and controlled-gate decomposition; no verified conversion.
notes: Paper links hetenyib repository; IBM repository describes Stim generators plus benchmark files from original cultivation. Its README gives an unrelated arXiv ID; 2603.05429 verified by title and authors.

title: Simulating magic state cultivation with few Clifford terms
conversion_notes: Python definitions contain extended Stim-like text with T and T_DAG; extract or use supplied definitions. Standard Stim cannot parse non-Clifford gates.
notes: Companion provides d=3 non-Clifford benchmark and Clifford proxy. Paper studies d=5; see 2609.18922 for fault-distance analysis.

title: Clifft: Fast Exact Simulation of Near-Clifford Quantum Circuits
conversion_notes: Use d=3 and d=5 cultivation workloads with T/T_DAG already present; extended Stim dialect is not parseable by standard Stim.
notes: SymFT README identifies msc_d3_inject_cultivate_p1e-3.stim and msc_d5_inject_cultivate_p1e-3.stim as byte-for-byte copies of Clifft published files. 2609.18922 analyzes fault distances.
